name: New Channel Integrations
description: Add Feishu/Lark, LINE, and DingTalk channel adapters to Pincer with full send/receive/streaming support. Three new channels covering East/Southeast Asia and Chinese enterprise markets.

userStories.title: Shared token cache GenServer
userStories.description: Extract a reusable TokenCache GenServer that manages OAuth2 client-credentials tokens with automatic refresh before expiry. Feishu and DingTalk both need this; LINE uses a static token but should still go through the cache for consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/shared/token_cache.ex implementing a GenServer that stores {token, expires_at}
TokenCache.get_token/1 returns cached token if not expired, otherwise refreshes via callback
TokenCache handles concurrent requests without stampede (refresh once, serve all waiters)
Token expires_at defaults to response value minus 60s safety margin
Create test/pincer/channels/shared/token_cache_test.exs covering: fresh token, expired refresh, concurrent access
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
TokenCache tests pass with mix test test/pincer/channels/shared/token_cache_test.exs
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/001-shared-token-cache. Files: lib/pincer/channels/shared/token_cache.ex, test/pincer/channels/shared/token_cache_test.exs. 6 tests pass.

userStories.title: Shared webhook signature verifier
userStories.description: Create a WebhookVerifier utility that validates incoming webhook signatures for each platform. Feishu uses X-Lark-Signature with SHA256, LINE uses X-Line-Signature with HMAC-SHA256, DingTalk uses URL param signature.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/shared/webhook_verifier.ex with three verification functions: verify_feishu/3, verify_line/3, verify_dingtalk/3
verify_feishu/3 computes SHA256(timestamp + nonce + body) and compares against X-Lark-Signature header
verify_line/3 computes HMAC-SHA256(body, channel_secret) base64-encoded and compares against X-Line-Signature header
verify_dingtalk/3 computes HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + "\n" + secret) base64-encoded and compares against sign URL param
All functions return :ok or {:error, :invalid_signature}
Create test/pincer/channels/shared/webhook_verifier_test.exs with known test vectors for each platform
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
WebhookVerifier tests pass
userStories.notes: Foundation for all three channel webhook handlers. Uses :crypto.hash/2 and Base.encode64/1 from Erlang stdlib.

userStories.title: Feishu API client (token + send + reply + card update)
userStories.description: Create the Feishu HTTP API client that handles tenant_access_token acquisition, sending messages, replying to messages, and updating interactive cards for streaming. Serves both Feishu (open.feishu.cn) and Lark (open.larksuite.com) via configurable base URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/feishu/api.ex with functions: get_tenant_token/0, send_message/3, reply_message/3, update_card/2
get_tenant_token/0 uses TokenCache (US-001) with app_id/app_secret from env vars FEISHU_APP_ID / FEISHU_APP_SECRET
send_message/3 accepts (receive_id, content, msg_type) and POSTs to /im/v1/messages with receive_id_type parameter
reply_message/3 accepts (message_id, content, msg_type) and POSTs to /im/v1/messages/{message_id}/reply
update_card/2 accepts (card_token, new_content) and PATCHes /interactive/v1/card/update
All API calls include Authorization: Bearer <token> header from TokenCache
API client reads base URL from config (open.feishu.cn or open.larksuite.com)
Create test/pincer/channels/feishu/api_test.exs with mocked HTTP responses
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
Feishu API tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 (TokenCache). Uses Req for HTTP (already in deps). Base URL: open.feishu.cn (CN) or open.larksuite.com (international).

userStories.title: Feishu card builder for streaming
userStories.description: Create a card builder module that constructs Feishu Interactive Card JSON payloads for progressive agent output. Cards support markdown content blocks that can be updated in-place during streaming.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/feishu/cards.ex with functions: create_card/1, update_card_content/2, build_markdown_element/1
create_card/1 returns a Feishu card JSON structure with a configurable markdown content element
update_card_content/2 takes an existing card config and replaces the markdown element body with new content
build_markdown_element/1 wraps text in the Feishu card markdown element format: {tag: "div", text: {tag: "lark_md", content: ...}}
Card JSON validates against Feishu card schema (correct tag names, required fields)
Create test/pincer/channels/feishu/cards_test.exs covering: card creation, content update, markdown escaping
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
Card builder tests pass
userStories.notes: Independent of API client. Pure data transformation module. Cards use Feishu CardKit v2 format.

userStories.title: Feishu channel adapter (Channel behaviour + webhook receive)
userStories.description: Implement the Feishu channel supervisor and Channel behaviour. Handles incoming webhook events (im.message.receive_v1), validates signatures via WebhookVerifier, parses text/image/file messages, and routes to session server. Implements send_message and update_message for agent output.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/feishu.ex implementing Supervisor + Pincer.Ports.Channel behaviour
start_link/1 reads config from config.yaml feishu section, ignores if token env vars missing
handle_webhook/2 validates signature via WebhookVerifier.verify_feishu/3, returns 401 on failure
Parses im.message.receive_v1 event: extracts sender open_id, message content (text/post/image/file), chat_id
Routes parsed messages to Pincer.Core.Session.Server.process_input/2 with session_id = "feishu_#{open_id}"
send_message/2 calls Feishu.API.send_message/3 with markdown-converted content
update_message/2 calls Feishu.API.update_card/2 for streaming updates
start_link starts Feishu.API and a webhook handler child process
Channel gracefully ignores (:ignore) if FEISHU_APP_ID or FEISHU_APP_SECRET env vars are missing
Create test/pincer/channels/feishu_test.exs with webhook event fixtures and mocked session routing
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
Feishu channel tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 (WebhookVerifier), US-003 (API client). Follow the same pattern as lib/pincer/channels/telegram.ex (Supervisor with child modules).

userStories.title: Feishu session callbacks (streaming + final response)
userStories.description: Implement the Feishu session module with on_agent_partial, on_agent_response, and on_agent_error callbacks. on_agent_partial updates the Feishu card in-place via update_card. on_agent_response sends the final complete message.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/feishu/session.ex using Pincer.Ports.Channel __using__ macro
on_agent_partial/2 creates a Feishu card on first token, then updates card content on subsequent tokens via Feishu.API.update_card/2
on_agent_response/2 sends the final message via Feishu.API.send_message/3 with full markdown content
on_agent_error/2 sends error text to the user via Feishu.API.send_message/3
Session tracks card_token in state for streaming updates (create once, update many)
Delegates to StreamDelivery module following the same pattern as Telegram.Session
Create test/pincer/channels/feishu_session_test.exs covering: partial streaming, final response, error handling
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
Feishu session tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-003 (API client), US-004 (cards), US-005 (channel adapter). Follow pattern from lib/pincer/channels/telegram/session.ex.

userStories.title: LINE API client (send reply + push + profile)
userStories.description: Create the LINE Messaging API HTTP client that handles sending reply messages (within 30s window), push messages (anytime), and user profile lookup. Uses static channel_access_token (no OAuth flow needed).
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/line/api.ex with functions: reply_message/2, push_message/2, get_profile/1
reply_message/2 accepts (reply_token, messages) and POSTs to https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/reply
push_message/2 accepts (to, messages) and POSTs to https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push
get_profile/1 accepts (user_id) and GETs https://api.line.me/v2/bot/profile/{userId}
All API calls include Authorization: Bearer <channel_access_token> header from env var LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
Messages formatted as LINE message objects: [{type: "text", text: "..."}]
Create test/pincer/channels/line/api_test.exs with mocked HTTP responses
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
LINE API tests pass
userStories.notes: No dependency on US-001 (TokenCache) since LINE uses a static token. Uses Req for HTTP.

userStories.title: LINE channel adapter (webhook receive + send + streaming)
userStories.description: Implement the LINE channel with Channel behaviour, webhook signature verification, message parsing, session routing, send_message, and chunked streaming (LINE has no message edit API, so streaming sends multiple follow-up messages).
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/line.ex implementing Supervisor + Pincer.Ports.Channel behaviour
start_link/1 reads config from config.yaml line section, ignores if LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var missing
handle_webhook/2 validates signature via WebhookVerifier.verify_line/3, returns 401 on failure
Parses LINE webhook events: extracts sender userId, message text, replyToken from events array
Routes parsed messages to Session.Server.process_input/2 with session_id = "line_#{userId}"
send_message/2 calls LINE.API.push_message/2 (for agent responses outside 30s window)
update_message/2 sends a new follow-up message via LINE.API.push_message/2 (LINE has no edit API)
Create lib/pincer/channels/line/session.ex with on_agent_partial (sends chunks), on_agent_response (sends final), on_agent_error callbacks
on_agent_partial accumulates tokens and sends a push_message every N characters or on sentence boundary to avoid spam
Channel gracefully ignores if env vars missing
Create test/pincer/channels/line_test.exs and test/pincer/channels/line_session_test.exs
mix format --check-formatted passes
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes
LINE channel tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 (WebhookVerifier), US-008 (LINE API). Streaming strategy: send initial message, then push follow-up chunks. Consider 500-char chunks.

userStories.title: DingTalk API client (token + send DM + send group + card update)
userStories.description: Create the DingTalk HTTP API client that handles access token acquisition, sending DMs via robot API, sending group messages, and creating/updating interactive cards for streaming.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/pincer/channels/dingtalk/api.ex with functions: get_access_token/0, send_dm/3, send_group/3, create_card/2, update_card/2
get_access_token/0 uses TokenCache (US-001) with client_id/client_secret from env vars DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID / DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET

send_group/3 accepts (conversation_id, message, msg_key) and POSTs to /v1.0/robot/groupMessages/send

update_card/2 accepts (card_instance_id, new_content) and PUTs /v1.0/card/instances/{card_instance_id}
